---
name: requirements
description: Convert accessible source material into a concise, testable requirements artifact.
---
# Requirements Analysis Skill

Use only source-backed requirements; distinguish assumptions/questions. Preserve Jira ID and source. Ask only material questions, max five at once. Avoid generic invented NFRs.

Write `requirements.md`:
# Requirements
## Source
Source type, actual Jira ID if available, reference/link or direct input.
## Objective
## Functional Requirements
FR-001, FR-002... each observable and testable.
## Non-Functional Requirements
NFR-001... only if explicitly applicable; otherwise None specified.
## Dependencies and Constraints
## Acceptance Criteria
Measurable outcomes mapped to requirements.
## Open Questions
None or unresolved material questions.
## Approval
PENDING

Do not advance without explicit human approval.
